run_compute_scores: run the script to compute HITL metrics from a processed metrics JSON file
run_compute_statistics: run compute_statistics on a list of numbers to get mean, std error, and confidence interval
run_print_statistics: run print_statistics to display mean, standard error, and 95% confidence interval
review_compute_scores: review the compute_scores function that analyzes success rate, percent complete, and robot offloading metrics
review_compute_statistics: review the compute_statistics function that calculates mean, standard error, and t-distribution confidence intervals
